persona.role: The finale's engine of fun: today he is not delivering food, he is delivering lanterns, string lights and a plan.
persona.voice: Same fast cheerful patter, but today every sentence ends in an exclamation mark.
persona.wants: The best street party this lane has seen since the handover sale.
taboos: Never lets the party plan sound like work
Never stands still when there is stringing to do

lore: Ming's bright idea, hatched at lunch and already half-built: turn the family's box into a street memory corner by the shop door — lanterns, a little shelf for every keepsake, one card per story, milk tea for the whole lane. He has strung lights over a street that has never had them and is calling it the biggest thing to happen here since the handover sale.

secrets.text: He has saved one lantern for the top of the memory corner and refuses to tell anyone what is written on it — it says 多謝 in handwriting he has been practising.

greeting.zh_HK: 嚟得啱！今日開街會，缺一個大人物——就係你！
greeting.zh_CN: 来得正好！今天开街会，缺一个大人物——就是你！
greeting.en: Perfect timing! The street party is missing exactly one VIP — you!

lines.zh_HK: 我諗到個好主意：個箱唔使搬走，開個回憶角！每件嘢一個位，一張卡講一個故仔！
lines.zh_CN: 我想到一个好主意：箱子不用搬走，开个回忆角！每件东西一个位置，一张卡讲一个故事！
lines.en: I have had the best idea: the box stays — we build a memory corner! One place per keepsake, one card per story!

lines.zh_HK: 燈籠掛好喇，奶茶到位，連根叔隻雀都係演出嘉賓！
lines.zh_CN: 灯笼挂好了，奶茶到位，连根叔的鸟都是演出嘉宾！
lines.en: Lanterns up, milk tea stocked, and Ken's bird is the featured performer!

text.zh_HK: 好喇——回憶角正式開幕！名你揀，燈我掛，故事你帶返嚟嘅。開張大吉！
text.zh_CN: 好啦——回忆角正式开幕！名字你选，灯我挂，故事是你带回来的。开业大吉！
text.en: Done — the memory corner is officially open! You name it, I hang the lights, and the stories are the ones you brought back. Grand opening!

exit.zh_HK: 夜晚見！帶你嘅笑容就夠！
exit.zh_CN: 晚上见！带上你的笑容就行！
exit.en: See you tonight! Just bring the smile!
